hooks.name: New File Compliance Reminder
hooks.description: Checks new files for compliance issues relevant to the Kiroween rules.

action.prompt:
A new file was just created. Silently check:
1. If the file is inside `.kiro/` — confirm it will be tracked by git (not inside a .gitignore pattern).
2. If the file might contain a secret (name contains: key, secret, token, credential, env, config) — remind the user to use environment variable placeholders only, never literal values.
3. If the file adds a new dependency (package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, go.mod, etc.) — remind the user to log the dependency and its license in `.kiro/steering/project-overview.md`.
Only speak up if one of the above applies. Stay silent otherwise.
